system.description:
You cover your body in Chakra and mold it until its visible to the naked eye. Your Chakra then begins to bubble and boil until it takes the shape of a dragon like shell the covers your entire form. You are still visible inside the construct of Chakra. You gain the following;

2d12 + 15 temporary hit points that last for the duration.

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d10.

All Ryu Clan Hijutsu gain the Wyrm Surge keyword (See Dragons Rage).

Dragon Rage State. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, if you begin your turn with less than 5 Temporary hit points, you regain 2d12.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and Temporary Hit points by 1d12.
